svc_lead: Some checks need a database or the application itself running. JGates starts those services on an isolated network only during the validation and shuts everything down at the end. Your compose files are never changed.
svc_governed: Governed mode: the services follow the policy and do not change here.
svc_noconfig: This project has no jgates.yml yet. Finish the guided setup to be able to save the services.
svc_files_help: The order of the list is the order of use: a file further down overrides the ones above it.
svc_files_none: No compose file was found in the project folder.
svc_problem: A file could not be read: {detail}
svc_services_none: The chosen files have no services.
svc_needed: Will start because another service depends on it
svc_effects_title: What this service does on your machine
svc_effect_bind_mount: Uses a folder of your computer, which it can read and change:
svc_effect_project_bind: Uses project files. JGates mounts them read-only:
svc_effect_privileged: Runs with almost full access to the machine:
svc_effect_device: Accesses a device of the computer:
svc_kind_privileged: Almost full access to the machine
svc_writable: Let {service} write to the project folder (read-only by default)
svc_app_help: The API and runtime security checks (ZAP, Schemathesis) need to know which service is your application and which port it answers on.
svc_app_port_undeclared: The compose file does not declare this service's port. Enter the port the application listens on.
svc_app_targets: Use {target} as the target of ZAP and Schemathesis
svc_test_help: Starts the services on an isolated network, waits for them to be healthy, shows the logs and shuts everything down.
svc_test_failed: The services did not become ready. Problem in: {service}.
svc_timeout: Maximum time for the services to become ready
svc_build: Let Compose build images from the project's Dockerfiles
svc_allow_help: Only applies to governed runs. In local mode JGates asks for your confirmation once for each change of the compose files.
svc_preview_same: Nothing changes: jgates.yml already has this configuration.
svc_preview_target: The target of the tool {tool} becomes
svc_ack_lead: These services reach your machine beyond the project. Confirm that you know this before saving.
svc_ack: I understand what these services do and want to use them
svc_err_CONFIG_MISSING: There is no jgates.yml yet. Finish the guided setup first.
svc_err_COMPOSE_EMPTY: The chosen files have no services.
svc_err_COMPOSE_FILE_MISSING: The file {file} does not exist in the project.
svc_err_COMPOSE_PATH_INVALID: Choose files from inside the project folder.
svc_err_SERVICE_UNKNOWN: The compose files have no service {service}.
svc_err_APPLICATION_MANY: Only one service can be the application under test.
svc_err_TARGET_PORT_REQUIRED: Choose the port of the application under test.
svc_err_REVISION_CONFLICT: jgates.yml changed since it was opened. Reload the page and try again.
svc_err_ACK_REQUIRED: Confirm the effects of the services before saving.
svc_err_SERVICES_NONE: No service was chosen to start.
svc_err_CONFIG_INVALID: The resulting configuration is not valid. Check the YAML.
svc_profiles_help: The services of a compose profile start only when it is checked here (services.profiles).
